title: Handbook of the Hinge-Link Combinations
summary: Links single swings into short two- and three-beat combinations that turn on the hinge link.

title: Treatise on Figure-Eight Pressure
summary: Uses the standing figure-eight to push an opponent back, bind an arm and open the guard.

title: Primer of the Whip-Snap Reach
summary: Teaches a Senior to snap the rod to the full length of the cord and recoil quickly.

title: Canon of the Looped Cord Binds
summary: Collects the ways of looping the cord over wrists, elbows and weapon shafts to bind and wrest.

title: Drill-Book of Rod and Elbow Transitions
summary: Trains smooth passes of the rods between hand, elbow, forearm and shoulder without breaking the swing.

title: Workbook of the Rebounding Counter
summary: Turns every parry into a springing return stroke using the rebound of qi-fed rods.

title: Treatise on the Twin-Rod Cadence
summary: Builds a steady alternating beat of the two rods and shows how to break an opponent's own rhythm.

title: Handbook of Close-Quarter Cord Work
summary: Shortens the grip and the swing for fighting inside arm's length where full orbits cannot turn.
